items.title: Ange Postecoglou confirms Spurs injury boost ahead of Man Utd clash
items.summary: Ange Postecoglou has delivered a positive injury update ahead of Sunday's Premier League fixture against Manchester United, confirming key midfielders are back in training.

items.title: 热刺 2-0 水晶宫：孙兴慜双响，热刺重返积分榜前六
items.summary: 英超第 9 轮，热刺主场 2-0 击败水晶宫，孙兴慜上下半场各入一球，延续近期出色状态。热刺积 15 分升至积分榜第六。

items.title: Tottenham monitor £40m-rated Portuguese winger as January transfer target
items.summary: Spurs scouts have been monitoring the 21-year-old winger's performances in the Primeira Liga, with a £40 million valuation expected in the January window.

items.title: 热刺训练课：新援首次参加合练，卢卡斯恢复完整训练
items.summary: 热刺本周四在 Hotspur Way 基地进行了赛前训练，夏季新援首次参与完整合练，此前受伤的卢卡斯·莫拉也回归了全队训练。

items.title: Commenting on Spurs' inconsistent start: What needs to change?
items.summary: After nine games, Tottenham sit mid-table with just three wins. Our football writer breaks down the tactical issues and what Ange needs to fix.

items.title: 孙兴慜：希望带领热刺拿到欧冠资格，这是我们的目标
items.summary: 孙兴慜在接受采访时表示，本赛季球队的目标是重返欧冠赛场，近期球队状态正在逐步回升。

items.title: Spurs linked with shock move for 22-year-old Bundesliga defender
items.summary: Tottenham are reportedly exploring the possibility of signing a RB Leipzig defender in January, with the player keen on a move to the Premier League.

items.title: 热刺客场 1-1 战平布莱顿，叒丢分了
items.summary: 英超第 8 轮，热刺客场 1-1 战平布莱顿，领先优势被扳平，错失全取三分的机会。

items.title: Micky van de Ven back in full training after hamstring injury
items.summary: Defender Micky van de Ven has resumed full team training after recovering from a hamstring problem that kept him out for the past month.

items.title: Ange 赛前发布会要点：谈曼联、谈转会窗、谈球队状态
items.summary: 波斯特科格鲁在赛前发布会上表示，球队目前状态不错，会为周末的比赛全力以赴，同时拒绝评论转会传闻。

items.title: Tottenham women's team secured dramatic late win in Women's Super League
items.summary: Spurs Women scored a 90th-minute winner to move up to fourth in the WSL table.

items.title: 热刺青训小将首次进入一线队大名单
items.summary: 19 岁青训中场首次入选一线队比赛日大名单，有望在本周联赛杯中完成首秀。
